title: Mealime Plan Meals Planned Leaderboard
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mealime:plan meals_planned=*
| stats sum(meals_planned) as total_value, avg(meals_planned) as avg_value by week_label
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks week values by total and average meals planned across Mealime meal plan events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `meals_planned` values for each Mealime meal plan event and review total and average meals planned by week.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total meals planned.
grandmaExplanation: It compares which week shows the biggest meals planned numbers in your Mealime meal plan data.
